notes: /v1/projecttask answers HTTP 400 'Either ProjectId or ProjectInternalId or PublicId must be specified' without a project filter (verified live 2026-09-29: a missing-parameter error, not a 'module not enabled' signal), so the endpoint is fetched once per project: partitioning lists /v1/project (walked completely and checked against its totalCount) and asks for projectId=<projectID>. One request per project at least (pilot 1,237). Rows get projectId (the project's code) added; projectInternalId is in the API's rows. An empty project list (a tenant without the project module) means nothing to fetch. DataMart projectTasks returns all 3,108 tasks across 1,219 projects in 7 pages of 500 and stays the cheaper source once its parity is proven.
